releaseNotes: New precisely aligned tutorial spotlights highlight only the control to tap without introducing extra gaps or glowing borders.
Tab explanations now sit directly above All Recipes, My Recipes or Shopping List with a small pointer to the exact tab.
Shopping guidance highlights the entire tickable item row and explains how meals in My Week feed the Shopping List.
The tutorial still supports tapping the real tabs, smooth scrolling, Next, Skip and replay from Settings.
Existing meals, preferences, favourites, inventory and shopping progress are preserved.
